eClerx, Arioli, Navi Mumbai. Senior Analyst. OTC Settlement 1st Dec 2022 to till Date

Job Description:

➢ Manage end-to-end OTC derivative trade life cycle, including pre-settlement, settlement, and

post-settlement activities.

➢ Perform trade validation and deal confirmations with clients and counterparties to ensure

accurate booking and settlement.

➢ Execute front-to-back trade and post-settlement reconciliations, identifying and resolving

economic discrepancies.

➢ Monitor exceptions and aged breaks, coordinating with Front Office, Middle Office, and

counterparties for timely resolution.

➢ Handle settlement instructions via SWIFT messaging (MT103, MT202) for EMEA and NY

markets.

➢ Perform SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) checks with four-eye control to ensure accuracy

and compliance.

➢ Actively support risk exposure management by resolving critical and high-risk outstanding

breaks.

➢ Ensure timely and accurate processing of all activities in line with defined SLAs and SOPs. ➢ Contribute to process efficiency projects, including automation through Excel macros, improving

turnaround time and accuracy.

➢ Prepare daily operational reports and support audits, compliance checks, and SOP updates. ➢ Train and mentor new joiners on derivative settlement processes and controls.

AWARDS AND ACHIEVEMENTS:

1) Rewarded with values award for 4 quarters for exceptional performance.

2) Rewarded with Business Special Award for stabilizing and streamlining the process for constantly clearing volumes.

3) Received appreciations from senior management for performing and maintaining quality work and owning the process.

4) Received appreciations from Client for performing and maintaining quality work and owning the process.

I declare the information in this document is true.

Dare: -

(Hitesh.Chhabria)
